senses.definition: A pressing; a force applied to a surface.
examples: Apply pressure to the wound to stop the bleeding.

senses.definition: (physics) The amount of force that is applied over a given area divided by the size of this area; force per unit area.
A contrasting force or impulse of any kind.
examples: the pressure of poverty; the pressure of taxes; the pressure of motives on the mind; the pressure of civilization.

quotes.text: When the pressure of danger was not felt.

examples: Do not let anyone pressure you into buying something you do not want.
